rows.note: Use this for an organized survey of people's opinions or information; it is the usual choice for an opinion survey.

example.english: The government conducted a survey to find out what citizens think of the new policy.
example.traditional: 政府做咗民意調查，了解市民對新政策嘅睇法。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 zou6 zo2 man4 ji3 diu6 caa4 liu5 gaai2 si5 man4 deoi3 san1 zing3 caak3 ge3 tai2 faat3

rows.note: Use this for an official or systematic check of the condition, quantity, or quality of things.

example.english: This survey by Customs checks the shipment's quantity and quality.
example.traditional: 海關今次會查呢批貨嘅數量同質素。
example.jyutping: hoi2 gwaan1 gam1 ci3 wui5 caa4 ni1 pai1 fo3 ge3 sou3 loeng6 tung4 zat1 sou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for surveying land or measuring the shape and dimensions of part of the Earth's surface.

example.english: The engineer will carry out a survey of the plot of land tomorrow.
example.traditional: 工程師聽日去測量塊地。
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 si1 ting1 jat6 heoi3 cak1 loeng4 faai3 dei6

rows.note: Use this when “survey” means the questionnaire or form that people fill in, rather than the research itself.

example.english: After you fill in this survey, you can enter the prize draw.
example.traditional: 填完呢份問卷，就可以參加抽獎。
example.jyutping: tin4 jyun4 ni1 fan6 man6 gyun2 zau6 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1 cau1 zoeng2
